m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Whoah! Talk about scary! I don't know how dangerous they are, but these titles sure are intimidating!
That was... elucidating. I think I even expanded my vocabulary. Let's see what's next.
Look, Master! It's the Ark already! Antipathy, that's the same as Empathy, right?
All right, so maybe I was wrong. Note to self: Antipathy is not a good thing. Let's just move on now.
And what are YOU doing in here? This chamber is for Spirits only. One step further and you will be banished... with extreme prejudice.
All right. That must be the real Ark of Empathy there. Let's take it and leave before we run into some other form of foolishness.
Back to Nabo-whatever-his-name-is. We need to get the Yakhal Chronoshard too, unless we want to turn Shamiss against us.
You survived the Halls of Confusion? You have the Ark? That must have required a great deal of courage, and insight. I am most amazed.
Oh. So it was the Guard? How refreshing! And here I was beginning to think no one cared about Knowledge and Communication any more.
That is why you've come, isn't it? I would be horribly disappointed otherwise.
Of course. My Master and I came here seeking a magical artifact. It's supposed to help overcome communication barriers...?
The Ark of Empathy? So not all the House Qhats have forgotten? The Qhats once used the Ark often. We kept it here in the Halls of Clarity.
But over time, the House Qhats withdrew from world politics and quit communicating. The Halls of Clarity have become the Halls of Confusion.
The Ark of Empathy remains, and you are welcome to it, but I fear disuse has driven even the books in there to turn dangerous. Good luck to you.
I wish there was another way to recover the Ark, but the House Qhats' isolation came at a price, and it seems you are the only one here to pay it.
